method: Same-baseline DEM comparison. Each body uses an approximately 12.8 km window (Moon 13.2 km, Mars 13.4 km due to integer native pixels) at its native DEM resolution: Earth 400 m / 463 m from Copernicus GLO-30 heightmaps, Moon 400 m from LOLA LDEM_45S_400M, Mars 463 m from MOLA. Slope and roughness are derived at the stated baseline. Absolute elevation uses body-specific datums and is not a cross-body similarity metric.

moon.name: Lunar south pole / Shackleton region
moon.source: LRO LOLA 400 m south-polar stereographic DEM (LDEM_45S_400M, PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0)
moon.note: Slope and roughness are derived from a DEM at the stated baseline. Absolute elevation uses a body-specific datum and is not a cross-body similarity metric.
